title: NetworkBranding - Metadata API
description: Represents the branding and color scheme applied to the login pages of an Experience Cloud site. (Experience Cloud sites are represented by the Network component.)

loginBackgroundImageUrl.description: The path to the image URL that appears as the background on the Experience Cloud site’s login page. This URL can be fixed, dynamic, or an uploaded image. A dynamic URL contains the experience ID parameter, {expid}, and is resolved dynamically at runtime.

loginFooterText.description: The text that appears in the footer of the Experience Cloud site login page.

loginLogo.description: The logo that appears on the Experience Cloud site login page for external users.

loginLogoName.description: The name of the logo that appears on the Experience Cloud site login page for external users.

loginPrimaryColor.description: The background color of the Login button. Available in API version 42.0 and later.

loginQuaternaryColor.description: The background color for the Experience Cloud site’s login page.

loginRightFrameUrl.description: The path to the content of the right frame of the Experience Cloud site login page. This URL can be either fixed or dynamic. A dynamic URL contains the experience ID parameter, {expid}. If the URL contains {expid}, the URL is resolved dynamically at runtime depending on the parameter's value.

network.description: The name of the Experience Cloud site associated with the branding.

pageFooter.description: An image that appears on the footer of the Experience Cloud site pages. Must be an.html file.

pageHeader.description: An image that appears on the header of the Experience Cloud site pages. Can be an.html,.gif,.jpg, or.png file.

primaryColor.description: The color used for the active tab.

quaternaryColor.description: The background color for pages in the Experience Cloud site.

secondaryColor.description: The color used for the top borders of lists and tables.

staticLogoImageUrl.description: The path to the logo that appears on the Experience Cloud site’s login page. This URL can be fixed, dynamic, or an uploaded image. A dynamic URL contains the experience ID parameter, {expid}. If the URL contains {expid}, the URL is resolved dynamically at runtime depending on the parameter's value.

tertiaryColor.description: The background color for section headers on edit and detail pages.

zeronaryColor.description: The background color for the header.

declarative_metadata_sample_definition.description: A sample XML definition of network branding.
